findings.issue: אָדָם is a common noun (H120, masculine singular absolute), not a proper name; adam leaves that lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
cita narrows מוֹעֵד (H4150, masculine singular plus 3ms suffix) toward a personal appointment; the lemma also stays open to appointed time, meeting, or place. su itself matches the suffix.

notes: Person, number, stems, Jehová, and Israel match the other tokens.
